notes.title: Early Access Demo will be back!
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for playing what we had for the game so far. After some consideration we decided to move forward with some approvements before re-releasing the demo. We've identified several problems with the current design, and while we had more planned that didn't make it into the demo, we will also work hard toward improving features that did make it into the demo.



As always, we hope you have a very gay day.

Yours truly,
Why Are You Games Team

notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
We're excited to share this news! Everyone in Why Are You Games has been working hard the past few weeks to ensure we delivered the best possible experience within the timeframe we had. This is by no means the final version, and we have a number of improvements and updates planned. 

However, we would gladly accept any feedback or opinions, and welcome any suggestions the community has. We're aware of a number of small bugs, and issues with the design and are working to improve on those. In order to get something out as quick as possible we decided to address most of these issues as we work on other levels.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello, we are happy to be able to release a part of our gameplay as an early access demo. We are still actively developing the game and the features are far from complete, but we wanted to release something early to gauge reactions and get an idea of what we are doing right.

We are a small team, and we're actively trying to improve. We hope you laugh and enjoy the demo for what it is, comedy. We're happy to receive any feedback, whether negative or positive. You don't need to worry about hurting our feelings haha. So feel free to tell us how shitty our game is, we don't mind.

Having said that, we are still waiting on the review process and wanted to make a few last minute changes to the demo. The demo should be available in 7-9 days. We look forward to seeing how gay you guys get *wink* *wink*.

Yours truly,
Why Are You Games Team
